reference_sql:
SELECT h.product_id, h.valid_from, h.unit_cost_eur,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id ORDER BY h.valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 2
       THEN ROUND(AVG(h.unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id ORDER BY h.valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2)
  END AS avg_cost_2v
FROM cost_history h
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = h.product_id
WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16)
alternatives:
SELECT h.product_id, h.valid_from, h.unit_cost_eur,
  ROUND((h.unit_cost_eur + LAG(h.unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id ORDER BY h.valid_from)) / 2, 2) AS avg_cost_2v
FROM cost_history h
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = h.product_id
WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16)

WITH w AS (
  -- one row per product per cost version
  SELECT h.product_id, h.valid_from, h.unit_cost_eur,
    AVG(h.unit_cost_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id ORDER BY h.valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_2,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY h.product_id ORDER BY h.valid_from ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n
  FROM cost_history h
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = h.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16)
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, unit_cost_eur, CASE WHEN n = 2 THEN ROUND(avg_2, 2) END AS avg_cost_2v
FROM w
